simple.meaning: בְּכוֹר (bᵉkôwr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “first-born ; hence, chief.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 10:15. The surrounding context includes birth, family, family line, firstborn.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּכוֹר (H1060) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: בְּכוֹר (bᵉkôwr) / H1060 is traced through Genesis 10:15, Genesis 22:21, Genesis 25:13, Genesis 27:19 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H1060. bekor בְּכוֺר 122 noun masculine first-born — Gen 35:23 78t.; בְּכֹר 25:13-14 t.; suffix בְּכֹּרִי 49:3 14 t.; בְּכוֺרוֺ 38:6 3 t.; plural construct בְּכוֺרֵי Neh 10:37 2 t.; בְּכוֺרֵיהֶם Psa 136:10 ; plural feminine בְּכֹרוֺת Gen 4:4 ; Neh 10:37 ; בְּכֹרֹת Deut 12:6 , 17 ; 14:23 ; — 1 men and women: a. individuals Gen 25:13 69t. b. collective Num 3:46 , 50 ; 8:16 ; 18:15 . c. plural Neh 10:37 ; Psa 135:8 ; 136:10 . d. בכור כל Exod 11:5 ; 12:12 , 29 ; 13:2 , 13 , 15 (twice in verse); 22:28 ; 34:2 ; Num 3:12 (3 t. in verse); 3:13 , 40 , 42 , 43 , 45 ; 8:17 (twice in verse); 8:18 ; 33:4 ; Psa 78:51 ; 105:36 . 2 animals: a. individuals Lev 27:26 ; Num 18:17 ; Deut 15:19 (twice in verse); 33:17 . b. collective בהמה בכור Exod 11:5 ; 12:29 ; 13:15 ; Num 3:41 ; 18:15 ; הבכור כל Deut 15:19 . c. plural בכרות Gen 4:4 ; Deut 12:6 , 17 ; 14:23 ; Neh 10:37 . 3 figurative , noun of relation מות בכור first-born of death Job 18:13 (deadly disease); דַלִּים בְּכוֺרֵי first-born of the poor (the poorest) Isa 14:30 ; Israel is the first-born of Yahweh among the nations Exod 4:22 compare Jer 31:9 ; and the seed of David among dynasties Psa 89:28 .
